data.name: Satesh
data.gender_notes: Satesh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who brings truth and wisdom to the world. The name Satesh carries the meaning “Lord of Truth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Satesh usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of truth and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes truth, purity, and wisdom. It is believed that Satesh bestows upon the bearer the power to discern truth and live a righteous life.
data.etymology: Satesh belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Truth.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Satesh total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
